changelog.summary: Spotlight: smoother exit animation — opacity + y drift replaces top clip-path
changes: page.tsx: replaced clip-from-top exit with opacity (1→0) + translateY (0→-56px) — GPU-composited, no hard edges
page.tsx: exit spring stiffness 90/damping 28/mass 0.8 — snappy but smooth trailing physics
page.tsx: entrance spring tuned heavier (stiffness 70/damping 24/mass 1.1) — drawer feels like a real weighted panel
page.tsx: exit opacity eases out early (45% through exit scroll range) so fade leads the drift — more premium feel

changelog.summary: Spotlight: bidirectional clip (reveal + retract), stronger background image
changes: page.tsx: added exit/retract animation — section clips from TOP as user scrolls past it toward services (useScroll target on section ref, offset start→end start)
page.tsx: combined top clip + bottom clip into single inset(top% 0% bottom% 0%) via useMotionTemplate — both directions share spring physics
page.tsx: exit spring slightly stiffer (58/18/0.75) so retraction feels snappy vs the softer reveal
page.tsx: background image opacity raised 0.22 → 0.38 for more visible oil/container texture
page.tsx: gradient overlay lightened (from-/88 via-/70) to let the image breathe through

changelog.summary: Spotlight section: atmospheric background image + layered glassmorphism card
changes: page.tsx: added /images/lubricants-oils.jpg as atmospheric background at 22% opacity with mix-blend-luminosity — ties the section visually to its product category
page.tsx: layered dark gradient overlay (from-[#070f1a]/95 → via-[#0d1829]/80) over the image for legibility
page.tsx: added right blue bloom + left cool sky glow for depth
page.tsx: wrapped left text panel in a frosted glass card (bg-white/6 backdrop-blur-2xl border-white/14 rounded-2xl) with inner shine and blue corner bloom
page.tsx: brightened category, body, and export text for better readability inside the glass card
page.tsx: upgraded tag chips to bg-white/10 border-white/20 with backdrop-blur-sm

changelog.summary: Product Spotlight: scroll-driven drawer animation, glassmorphism background, removed bottom fade
changes: page.tsx: converted spotlight section to motion.section with scroll-driven clip-path — reveals top-to-bottom as user scrolls (drawer effect), reverses on scroll-up
page.tsx: useScroll + useTransform [0,620] → clip [100%→0%] + useSpring (stiffness 52, damping 17, mass 0.85) for physics-based silky reveal
page.tsx: useMotionTemplate composites spring value into inset() clip-path string at every animation frame with zero jank
page.tsx: prefers-reduced-motion respected — animation skipped, section remains fully visible
page.tsx: replaced flat bg-sidebar with glassmorphism (from-[#0d1829] to-sidebar gradient + backdrop-blur-2xl + border-t/b border-white/9%)
page.tsx: added hairline glass shine overlay at top edge via-white/30 gradient
page.tsx: removed bottom fade gradient and engineering grid overlay

changelog.summary: Performance: AVIF images, font preload reduction, CSS compositor animations, marquee DOM fix
changes: next.config.mjs: added AVIF as primary image format (30-50% smaller than WebP), enabled server-side compression (gzip/brotli), tuned device/image size breakpoints
next.config.mjs: added immutable 1-year cache header for /fonts/*, 7-day stale-while-revalidate for /images/* and /videos/*

layout.tsx: reduced font preload from 10 files to 4 critical files (barlow-700, barlow-800, jakarta-400, jakarta-500) — other weights load on-demand via browser font matching; saves 6 blocking HTTP requests on first visit
layout.tsx: added dns-prefetch for tile.openstreetmap.org (map tiles)
globals.css: CTA world-map animated pins converted from 28 Framer Motion JS animations to 4 CSS @keyframes classes — animations now run entirely on the compositor thread with zero JS involvement
globals.css: prefers-reduced-motion hides pin rings entirely for accessibility
page.tsx: marquee DOM count reduced from 192 nodes to 24 (was partners×8 due to double-expansion bug; now partners×2 which is correct for the CSS -50% translateX loop)
page.tsx: removed unused useInView import from framer-motion

changelog.summary: Fix brand logos — switch from dead Clearbit CDN to Wikimedia Commons

changes.description: All 12 partner logos now use verified Wikimedia Commons URLs (logo.clearbit.com DNS stopped resolving after HubSpot acquisition). Each filename was individually confirmed accessible via the Wikimedia Special:Redirect API at 200px width.
main.ts CSP imgSrc: replaced logo.clearbit.com with upload.wikimedia.org and commons.wikimedia.org so Helmet doesn't block logo images served from Wikimedia

changelog.summary: Fix admin login loop and brands not showing — env and DB init

changes.description: .env and .env.local: restored NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to http://localhost:4000 — using the USB tethering IP (192.168.42.10) caused a cross-site SameSite=Lax cookie issue where admin_jwt was never sent after login, causing an infinite login redirect loop

db-init.service: removed multi-statement UPDATE block (one db.execute() per statement is required by node-postgres) that was crashing onModuleInit() and taking the entire API down on startup — this caused both the login failure and the brands marquee showing nothing
partners table: added UNIQUE constraint on name column + changed seed INSERT to ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE — prevents duplicate rows from being created on every API restart
partners seed: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE now also upserts logo_url, sector, products, and website — existing rows without logos are automatically updated on next restart

changelog.summary: Seed correct official logos for all 12 partner brands via Clearbit CDN

changes.description: db-init.service: INSERT now includes logo_url for all 12 partners (TotalEnergies, Shell, Caterpillar, Volvo, Komatsu, Cummins, Maersk, CMA CGM, DHL, Bolloré, Liebherr, Eiffage) using logo.clearbit.com CDN
UPDATE migration runs on every restart to backfill logo_url on existing partner rows that were inserted without a logo — safe and idempotent (only updates rows where logo_url is null or empty)

changes.description: CORS: allowed origins now read from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL env var — no longer hardcoded to localhost only, production domain is automatically allowed
next.config.mjs: added output: 'standalone' — Next.js now bundles all runtime dependencies into .next/standalone/ for VPS deployment with Node.js
ecosystem.config.js: PM2 process config added at repo root for Hostinger VPS deployment — manages both ltic-api (NestJS port 4000) and ltic-web (Next.js port 3000)

CustomerContext and CustomerProvider removed from the app — no longer needed

changelog.summary: Fix quote-to-order conversion not working

changes.description: Replaced two chained useMutation calls (createOrderMutation → updateQuoteMutation inside onSuccess) with a single async handleSubmit that awaits both API calls directly — eliminates stale closure on convertQuote state and shows the real error message if either call fails

changelog.summary: Convert quote to order directly from the Quotes page

changelog.summary: Add How to Order step-by-step guide on home page and quote page

changes.description: Home page: new 'How to Place an Order' section with 4 animated steps (Browse Catalog → Request Quote → Receive Offer → Track Shipment), each with an icon, step number badge, description, and action link
Quote page sidebar: replaced generic note with a numbered 'What happens next?' process guide showing exactly what happens after form submission

changelog.summary: Real-time admin profile updates across all admin pages via shared context

changes.description: AdminProfileContext: new React context that holds the admin profile (name, email, avatarUrl) — fetched once on mount and shared across all admin components
AdminLayout: wraps all admin pages with AdminProfileProvider so every page gets the same live profile state
Profile page: uses setProfile from context on every successful save (name, email, avatar) — sidebar and any other consumer instantly reflect the change without page reload
AdminSidebar: reads username and avatarUrl from context instead of fetching independently — updates immediately when the profile page saves

changelog.summary: Fix uploaded profile picture not displaying — route uploads through Next.js proxy

changes.description: next.config.mjs: added rewrite /uploads/:path* → API_ORIGIN/uploads/:path* so uploaded images are served same-origin from the Next.js server, eliminating the Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy block that prevented localhost:3000 from loading images stored on localhost:4000
Profile page and AdminSidebar: changed avatar src from ${API_URL}${avatarUrl} to just avatarUrl (relative path) — the Next.js rewrite transparently proxies it to the API

changelog.summary: Fix broken profile picture display on My Profile page and sidebar

changes.description: Profile page: added avatarError state + onError handler on the avatar — broken image no longer shows alt text overlaid on the circle; falls back cleanly to the initial-letter circle instead
AdminSidebar: same onError fallback pattern applied to the sidebar avatar thumbnail

changelog.summary: Revert admin sidebar profile section redesign

changes.description: Reverted AdminSidebar profile card redesign — restored original layout with avatar + name inline in the header section

changelog.summary: Fix profile picture not loading on My Profile page and admin sidebar

changes.description: API: added crossOriginResourcePolicy: false to Helmet config — Helmet 8 defaults to Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin which blocked the Next.js frontend (localhost:3000) from loading uploaded images from the API (localhost:4000)
AdminSidebar: fixed avatar img src using the raw relative path /uploads/... which resolved to localhost:3000/uploads/... — now correctly prepends NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to form the full API URL

changelog.summary: Display admin profile avatar in sidebar header

changes.description: AdminSidebar: fetch GET /api/admin/profile on mount (credentials: include) to get avatarUrl; display the avatar image (or an initial-letter fallback circle) next to the admin name in the sidebar header

changelog.summary: Fix login page skipping the form and redirecting directly to admin dashboard

changes.description: Login page: replaced single checkAuth() call (admin-only) with parallel checks of both admin and customer sessions — if admin cookie exists, redirect to /admin/dashboard; if customer cookie exists, redirect to /account; otherwise show the login form. Previously any valid admin_jwt cookie caused the login page to bypass the form entirely and redirect all visitors to /admin/dashboard.

changelog.summary: Fix admin profile and changelog pages not loading after cookie migration

changes.description: Admin profile page: removed stale import of getAdminToken (deleted when auth was migrated to httpOnly cookies), replaced Bearer token header with credentials: 'include' so admin_jwt cookie is sent automatically
Admin changelog page: same fix — removed getAdminToken import and switched to credentials: 'include' for all admin API calls
Admin avatar upload: removed Authorization header with token, now sends cookies via credentials: 'include'

changelog.summary: Fix admin login redirect loop caused by ThrottlerGuard applying login throttle to auth-check endpoints

changes.description: Added @SkipThrottle({ login: true, form: true }) at class level to all 16 API controllers — the global ThrottlerGuard was applying the restrictive login throttle (5 req/15 min) to every route including GET /admin/me, causing the admin panel to return 429 after just 5 page loads and redirect back to the login screen

Login and form-submission endpoints that need rate limiting (POST /auth/login, POST /auth/forgot-password, POST /contacts, POST /quotes, POST /customers/login) retain their throttles via per-method @Throttle() decorators which override the class-level skip

changelog.summary: Fix API startup crash caused by .env misconfiguration

changes.description: SESSION_SECRET extended to 32+ characters — Zod min(32) check was failing, preventing the API from starting
Removed duplicate ADMIN_EMAIL= (empty) line in .env that was overriding the real value and failing Zod email validation
Zod env schema: optional email and URL fields now accept empty string (treated as undefined) so blank MAIL_USER=, MAIL_PASS= etc. never crash the API
Created apps/web/.env.local with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL so Next.js picks up the API URL at build time

changelog.summary: Password reset, email verification, and transactional confirmation emails

changes.description: POST /api/auth/forgot-password: generates a 32-byte secure token, stores it in password_reset_tokens table (1-hour TTL), sends reset-link email; always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration
POST /api/auth/reset-password: validates token not used and not expired, bcrypt-hashes the new password, marks token used — returns 400 on bad/expired token
Frontend forgot-password page at /auth/forgot-password: email form with success state; forgot-password link added below the password field on the login page
Frontend reset-password page at /auth/reset-password: reads ?token= from URL, validates and submits new password, auto-redirects to login on success
Email verification on customer registration: generates a 32-byte secure token with 24-hour TTL, sends verification email; GET /api/customers/verify?token= endpoint marks account as verified
Frontend verify-email page at /auth/verify-email: auto-verifies on load, shows success/error state, refreshes customer profile
Account dashboard: amber warning banner shown when emailVerified is false with instructions to check inbox
Confirmation emails: quote submitters receive a branded confirmation email; contact form submitters receive a confirmation email (fire-and-forget, does not block response)
customers schema: added emailVerified, emailVerificationToken, emailVerificationExpires columns to Drizzle schema for type-safe access
sanitize() in customers.service: now strips emailVerificationToken and emailVerificationExpires from API responses in addition to passwordHash

changelog.summary: JWT authentication migrated from localStorage to httpOnly cookies

changes.description: API startup: cookie-parser middleware enabled for reading httpOnly cookies from requests
POST /api/auth/login: sets admin_jwt or customer_jwt httpOnly cookie (SameSite=Lax, Secure in production) instead of returning raw token; also adds POST /api/auth/logout to clear cookies
POST /api/customers/login and /register: set customer_jwt httpOnly cookie (7-day maxAge); POST /api/customers/logout clears the cookie
AuthGuard: reads admin_jwt cookie first, falls back to Authorization Bearer header for API clients
CustomerGuard: reads customer_jwt cookie first, falls back to Authorization Bearer header; removed hardcoded secret fallback
SseAuthGuard: reads admin_jwt cookie first (EventSource sends cookies with withCredentials), falls back to ?token= query param
Frontend api.ts: removed Authorization header injection — cookies are sent automatically by the browser with credentials: include
CustomerContext: removed all localStorage.getItem/setItem for customer_token — session managed entirely by httpOnly cookie
Login page, profile page, MediaUpload, AdminSidebar SSE, tracking page: all localStorage token reads replaced with cookie-based approach

changelog.summary: Replace TypeScript any with proper interfaces throughout the API

changes.description: Exported Db type alias (NodePgDatabase<typeof schema>) from db.module.ts — all 12 services/controllers now use Db instead of any for the Drizzle ORM instance
news.service.ts / news.controller.ts: create() accepts NewNewsArticle, update() accepts Partial<NewsArticle>
quotes.service.ts / quotes.controller.ts: create() accepts NewQuote, update() accepts Partial<Quote>
contacts.service.ts / contacts.controller.ts: create() accepts NewContact, update() accepts Partial<Contact>
orders.service.ts / orders.controller.ts: update() accepts Partial<Order>; create body inferred from service signature
categories.controller.ts: inline CategoryBody interface replaces body: any for create and update
products.controller.ts: inline ProductBody and ProductQuery interfaces replace body/query: any

changelog.summary: SSE real-time push for admin notifications

changes.description: GET /api/notifications/stream: Server-Sent Events endpoint — emits a message event whenever a new notification is created (new quote or contact submission)
SseAuthGuard: validates admin JWT from ?token= query param (required because browser EventSource cannot set Authorization headers)
AdminSidebar: opens an EventSource connection on mount; increments the unread badge instantly on push instead of waiting for the 30-second poll; 60-second fallback poll kept for resilience

changelog.summary: Order creation UI in admin panel, customer_id FK on orders, admin customer list

changes.description: Admin Orders page: Add Order button opens a dialog — auto-generates tracking number (LTIC + YYMM + 6 random digits), supports optional customer link, origin, destination, description, status, and estimated delivery
Admin Orders page: delete button with ConfirmDialog on each order row
orders schema: added customer_id integer column with ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS migration run at startup
GET /api/customers (admin-protected): lists all registered customers for the order customer-link dropdown
Customer My Orders: now matches by customerId OR clientEmail so linked orders appear in the account dashboard
DELETE /api/orders/:id and GET /api/orders/customer/:customerId endpoints added
Removed last || 'ltic-secret' JWT fallback in admin.controller.ts — all token signing now requires SESSION_SECRET

changelog.summary: Zod env var validation at API startup

changes.description: API startup now validates all environment variables with Zod schema — SESSION_SECRET must be ≥32 chars, DATABASE_URL must be non-empty, ADMIN_EMAIL must be a valid email if set; prints each failing field with its reason before exiting
Replaced manual REQUIRED_ENV for-loop with structured Zod validation that catches misconfigured optional vars (bad email format, short secrets) in addition to missing required ones

changelog.summary: Back-to-top button and breadcrumb navigation on product and news detail pages

changes.description: BackToTop button: appears after scrolling 400px, smooth-scrolls to top, positioned above the WhatsApp floating button
Breadcrumb component: reusable nav with ChevronRight separators, clickable links for parent routes, bold current page label
Product detail page: breadcrumb Home > Products > Category > Product Name replaces the back arrow link
News article page: breadcrumb Home > News > Article Title replaces the back arrow link

changelog.summary: Admin search on products, categories, and news; admin products pagination

Admin Categories: search bar filters by name (EN/FR) and slug
Admin News: search bar filters articles by title (EN/FR)

changelog.summary: Product search on public catalog with debounce

changes.description: Public product catalog: debounced search input (350ms) — filters products by name in both English and French via ?search= query parameter
Empty state message now shows the search term when no results are found

changelog.summary: Per-page SEO metadata on all public pages using Next.js server component wrappers

changes.description: generateMetadata on /products/[slug] — fetches product name, description, and image server-side for unique Open Graph per product
generateMetadata on /news/[id] — fetches article title, summary, and image for unique Open Graph per news article (includes publishedTime)
Static metadata added to About, Services, Contact, News list, Products list, and Quote pages via server component re-export wrappers

changelog.summary: Real MIME type validation on file uploads + remove SVG from allowed types

changes.description: Upload endpoint: removed SVG from allowed extensions (SVG can carry XSS payloads); now only allows JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM
Upload endpoint: file-type@16 reads magic bytes from disk after multer saves the file; rejects and deletes the file if content type doesn't match declared extension
Avatar upload: same MIME check applied — only allows JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP based on both declared Content-Type and real file content

changelog.summary: Drop ghost users table, tracking page privacy masking, sitemap + robots

changes.description: Removed ghost CREATE TABLE users and notifications SQL from db-init.service.ts — these unused tables will no longer be created on new installs
Tracking page: clientName, origin, and destination are masked for unauthenticated visitors with a 'Login to view' link — prevents personal data exposure
Added sitemap.ts (Next.js built-in) at /sitemap.xml covering all static pages and dynamically fetching product/category/news slugs
Added robots.ts (Next.js built-in) at /robots.txt — allows all crawlers on public pages, blocks admin routes

changelog.summary: Priority images on hero sections + AlertDialog confirmations for delete actions in admin

changes.description: Added priority prop to hero <Image> on all 6 public pages (about, services, news, contact, quote, products) — eliminates LCP image-not-prioritized warning

changelog.summary: Fix blank product detail page — fetch by slug directly, sanitize slugs

changelog.summary: Fix product creation 500 error — validation + error handling

changelog.summary: Unified login page, role-based redirection, secure admin profile settings

changes.description: Single login page at /auth/login handles both admins and customers — POST /api/auth/login checks admin_profile first, then customers table; returns role in response
Role-based redirection after login: admin → /admin/dashboard, customer → /account; supports ?redirect= query param
AuthGuard now rejects customer tokens (role: 'customer') from accessing admin routes — closes privilege escalation gap
Admin email change secured: PATCH /api/admin/profile/email requires current password verification (bcrypt) before updating
Admin profile page redesigned into four sections: avatar, display name, email address (with password confirmation), change password
Password minimum length raised to 8 characters; bcrypt cost raised from 10 to 12
/admin now redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/login instead of showing a separate login form
AdminSidebar redirects to /auth/login (not /admin) on token expiry or auth failure

changelog.summary: Admin email+password login via DB profile, auto-push workflow, CLAUDE.md

changes.description: Admin login now accepts email + password validated against admin_profile table (bcrypt); falls back to ADMIN_PASSWORD env var until a password is set via the Profile page
Admin login page: username field replaced with email field (with Mail icon); helpful hint pointing to Profile page for credential changes
GET /api/admin/me now returns the admin's display name from admin_profile instead of the raw token claim
ADMIN_EMAIL env var seeds the initial admin_profile email on first startup (default: admin@ltic-sarl.com)
CLAUDE.md added — instructs future Claude sessions to auto-push changes to GitHub with version control after every task

AdminSidebar: Bell icon with live red unread count badge, polling every 30 seconds
